misprints.note: Koppa, v. tr.: the print clearly begins with κ; the verb for cupping is σικυάζειν.
This is what the print shows. The form is not attested in the corpus.

uncertain.note: Kopparmynt: the article after χαλκοῦς is broken type that looks like ι with a rough breathing; I read it as ὁ.
No breathing is visible on έως. This matches the usual genitive ending notation.
